_provenance: Raised by engine/watch.py on 2026-08-16: two outlets reported a run-rate above $40B against a stored $25B dated 2026-06-12. Checked against PitchBook profile 149504-14 (retrieved 2026-08-16), whose TTM 4Q2026 revenue field reads $41.3B. Those two are close but not independent confirmation of each other: PitchBook's TTM is a forward window under ruling R3 and the press figure is a company-sourced print, so only the press figure enters the ladder, at T3. The headcount signal in the same scan was a false positive; PitchBook still reads 4,500 and no change is recorded.

run_rate_ladder_bn.source: Press reports, Aug 13-14 2026, that annualised revenue tops $40B
run_rate_ladder_bn.note: Reported by two outlets on consecutive days, both framing it against the coming listing. Ruling R4 governs any comparison with Anthropic: OpenAI reports net, Anthropic gross, and the two are never compared raw.

pb_revenue_ttm_bn.source: PitchBook Revenue field, fiscal period TTM 4Q2026
pb_revenue_ttm_bn.note: House ruling R3: a forward-window projection, not a run-rate. Kept because its closeness to the $40B press print is a weak corroboration of direction, not of level.
